tangent.implementation: central difference of the corrected element internal force
tangent.accepted_state_policy: same detached accepted material states are supplied to base, plus and minus evaluations; no trial evaluation mutates the accepted input
tangent.step: h=1e-5*V0^(1/3), with V0 assembled from reference integration measures
diagnostics: classical derivative claim only if no branch switch
tangent.yield_switch_policy: central secant may be returned to bounded Newton; branch switches are exposed and classical derivative claim is false. No general semismooth convergence theorem is claimed.

preregistered_r1_a10.direction: seed-27 normal variate in R^12, Euclidean normalized

bounded_tet4_noncoaxial_plastic_probe.accepted_state: plastic preload from F=diag(1.016,0.992,0.992), then independent smooth noncoaxial displacement gradient

yield_surface_probe.method: construct diagonal affine deformation at elastic trial yield boundary and inspect perturbation branches
yield_surface_probe.one_sided_direction: normalized affine nodal perturbation associated with F_xx
yield_surface_probe.positive_side: active plastic branch at each sampled step
yield_surface_probe.negative_side: elastic branch at each sampled step

independent_force_reference_context.r3_directional_oracle: Calls corrected force/state evaluation directly, independently of the tangent-producing method; this independently differentiates the implemented force but shares the physical force kernel.
independent_force_reference_context.r2_incremental_potential_oracle: Separately coded local J2 incremental-potential gradient, fixed accepted states, elastic/active-plastic/noncoaxial TET4; retained as R2 bounded force verification and not reclassified as an R3 tangent oracle.
independent_force_reference_context.qualification: Neither comparison is qualification or evidence for general finite-strain plasticity.
